answer.native_seed_size: All three approved seeds are 1280x720 native direct-source PNGs.
answer.repo_side_input_handling: run_source_hunyuan.py passes the seed PNG path and its SHA-256 to run_source_panogen.py; the panorama launcher passes the same path to the Hunyuan demo. No repository code resizes, crops or composites the seed.
answer.input_size_recorded_by_hunyuan: No input width/height is recorded for video attempts. attempt_config.json width/height are the requested panorama output dimensions, not the seed input. Only picture-set GPU guards record seed_image_width/seed_image_height.
answer.panorama_output_size: Every produced panorama is 512x256. Two frame_1097 attempts requested 768x384 and failed; no 768x384 panorama was produced.
answer.upstream_unknown: The Hunyuan/Panogen runtime path recorded in the configs (/mnt/sharedOs/backrooms-track-a-runtime) is absent now, so its internal input preprocessing cannot be inspected. Do not infer the accepted input size from this record.
answer.open_question: Whether a sharper or larger seed frame improves a panorama is not answered by these configs or by arXiv 2610.33656. Testing it needs GPU attempts, which the operator must authorise.
